title: Conditions, discretion, and termination rights
summary: The consideration-and-interpretation unit supplies several ways to identify a real obligation.
notes: Read satisfaction in Mattei, requirements in Structural Polymer, and efforts in Wood in the whole agreement. A condition on performance differs from an absence of agreement; a variable quantity differs from an unrestricted choice; an exclusive grant can imply an efforts duty. The later Wood notes ask about termination at will and reasonable notice. Each limitation must be supported by the language, context, or provision actually used.
